import json, re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/INTEL_2016_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)['texts']
terms=['long-term debt','year-end','long term debt','debt at year-end','debt']
for term in terms:
    print('\\nTERM',term)
    pat=re.compile(term,re.I)
    for i,t in enumerate(data):
        if pat.search(t['text']):
            print(i, t['page_no'], t['text'][:200].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
